_what_this_is: Per-site dispositions for tools/scan_own_code.py, keyed by a hash of file plus the line's text so that editing a line invalidates its disposition. Only sites READ INDIVIDUALLY appear here. Everything else stays undispositioned and keeps failing the scan, because marking 37 sites legitimate from a sample of 8 would be the bulk rubber-stamp this project criticised in its own prose gate.
